name: io.github.bibinprathap/veritasgraph
description: The first zero-trust, air-gapped Enterprise GraphRAG server for MCP. Build knowledge graphs from local documents and run multi-hop, citation-grounded queries entirely offline.

environmentVariables.name: VERITASGRAPH_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Default local Ollama model for ingest/query (e.g. qwen3:latest).

environmentVariables.name: STUDIO_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where the knowledge-graph snapshot is persisted.
